Sandbox modes

A sandbox binds what a command can touch. There are three modes.

readonly

The workspace is mounted read-only; everything else is not mounted at all.

workspace

The workspace is mounted read-write.

[sandbox]
mode = "workspace"
network = "loopback"

Allowlist

valuemeaning
noneno egress
loopback127.0.0.1 only
  • a promised sandbox is never silently dropped
An unavailable backend refuses the command instead of running it unsandboxed.
